response.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(l.DNA), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_anti_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_alb_minus_tp FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` > 180 GROUP BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: Laboratory.DNA is stored as text. I treat blank or whitespace-only DNA values as missing and cast the rest to numbers before averaging. Any non-numeric text would be read as 0.
A patient whose SEX is NULL, if there is one, forms its own group, as does one whose SEX is a blank string. The average of ALB − TP uses only rows where both values are present.
